verdict.rationale: Insomnia offers narrow natural-language features — generating a mock server from a prompt (insomnia-docs-10, insomnia-docs-29) and AI-assisted commit messages (insomnia-docs-35) — plus an MCP Client that lets external agents discover and invoke Insomnia elements (insomnia-docs-30, insomnia-docs-14). These are isolated AI touchpoints, not a general natural-language command interface for operating the whole app (building requests, running collections, editing environments, etc.). Missing for 10: broad NL-driven control of core workflows (request building, test running, environment management), independent hands-on validation of the NL mock-generation feature, and evidence NL commands can drive anything beyond mock scaffolding.
